sample_answers.tell_me_about_yourself: I am Anees Munir Khokhar, an AI Engineer based in Islamabad, specializing in production-grade RAG pipelines, agentic AI workflows, and computer vision systems. Holding a BS in Artificial Intelligence from UAJK, I bridge the gap between complex AI research architectures and scalable, high-concurrency production applications. Whether designing multi-provider retrieval engines like Easy-Study or containerized microservices, my focus is always on engineering precision, automated testing, and real-world impact.
sample_answers.why_should_we_hire_you: You should hire me because I combine AI engineering with backend development and practical product-building skills. I can work on LLM apps, RAG pipelines, AI agents, APIs, databases, testing, and deployment. My focus is not just building prototypes, but creating usable and maintainable AI systems.
sample_answers.explain_easy_study: Easy-Study is my flagship RAG project. It can ingest PDFs, YouTube videos, web articles, and notes, convert them into embeddings, store them in a FAISS vector database, and answer questions using different LLM providers like Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, and OpenAI. I designed it to be modular, practical, and useful for students.
